about:
RDM Industrial Electronics Inc is headquartered in Nebo, North Carolina, and operates fully stocked branches in Colorado, Florida, Indiana, Texas, Pennsylvania, and Georgia. Ownership and founding details are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in new and remanufactured petroleum electronic equipment, including circuit boards, intercoms for convenience stores, fuel dispenser security systems, displays, printers, card readers, motors, keypads and overlays, point-of-sale systems, consoles, tank monitors, and probes. RDM employs degreed technicians and engineers across its divisions—Petroleum, Car Wash, Intercom, Industrial, and Medical—and maintains ready-to-ship inventory at every location.

RDM’s customer base spans petroleum retailers, convenience stores, car wash operators, industrial facilities, and medical equipment users. Concrete examples include supplying intercom systems to convenience stores, fuel dispenser security modules to petroleum sites, and tank monitoring probes to industrial and medical clients.

RDM states that its differentiators are the use of degreed technical staff, free technical support and training, and a commitment to the quickest delivery in the industry with five-star quality products and customer service.
